clips.title: The story
paras: The Demon Scarred Cloak is a ragged pelt recovered from the legendary white wolf Ghost Howl, who roams the grassy plains of Mulgore. Marked by an enduring wound inflicted during past clashes with the Burning Legion, the pelt serves as proof of the beast's release from torment. Bringing it to the elders of Bloodhoof Village brings closure to the story of a tragic local legend.

Ghost Howl is an elusive white wolf known across Mulgore for both his ferocity and his sorrowful howl. When slain, the beast leaves behind a pelt that is visibly scarred by foul demonic corruption. These lingering marks date back to the wolf's desperate battles against the invading demons of the Burning Legion, a confrontation that left Ghost Howl wounded in both flesh and spirit long after the Third War came to a close.

The tauren of Mulgore maintain a deep respect for the wild beasts of their homeland, revering them as children of the Earth Mother. Presenting the scarred cloak to Skorn Whitecloud in Bloodhoof Village confirms the demise of the tormented predator. Skorn recognizes the immense skill required to track and defeat Ghost Howl, expressing the somber hope that in death, the wolf's tortured spirit has finally attained peace.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the Burning Legion.
Perhaps someone in Bloodhoof Village should know of Ghost Howl's demise....

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can barely believe my old eyes! You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl? I look upon you with new respect, young adventurer. You are a hunter of extreme skills!
Let me offer you something. My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.
May it strike true, and bring you renown.
And let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.
